# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Hash seed hardening**

## Highlights

The shared hash-code implementation now seeds its per-process randomization from the operating system's cryptographic random generator. This applies to both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Stronger per-process hash seeds** — Replaces System.Random with RandomNumberGenerator for the shared HashCode seed, preserving within-process stability. First use now initializes cryptographic services. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
